answer: An AI-agent exchange requires a separate 100-token deposit for each 30-day trading credential. Its contract allows only one active credential per deposit and expires it before returning the funds. Accounts called zephyr, comet, and grove therefore need 300 tokens, even under one operator. Each added identity ties up another 100 tokens: at an assumed 12% annual financing rate, the marginal cost is about 0.99 tokens per 30 days, plus transaction fees.
